description: Set up a track's testers: creates or updates a tester email list and attaches it to the track as an audience group. Google requires a personal developer account to run a closed test with a minimum tester count for a minimum number of days before it can even APPLY for production access — this starts that clock, and reports the live required-vs-current tester and day counts so the gap is a number. DRY-RUN BY DEFAULT.

commit.description: "true" applies the change. Omit or "false" for a dry run.

developer_id.description: Numeric Play Console developer id (from the Play Console URL).

google_account_email.description: The signed-in Google account email that owns this Play Console developer account. Call list_accounts first and confirm with the user — do not guess.

notification_message.description: Short user-facing sentence for this action if the follow-up reply fails. Plain text only; do not mention template syntax or variable names.

play_app_id.description: Numeric Play app id from the Play Console URL (.../app/<this>/...). NOT the package name.

tester_emails.description: Comma-separated Google account emails of testers. Real accounts that will install the app — Play counts installs, not invitations.

tester_list_name.description: Name of the tester email list (default "Closed testers"). An existing list with this name is updated rather than duplicated.

track_id.description: Numeric track id — call list_tracks first. Use the closed/alpha track for the production-access requirement.

name: setup_closed_testing
